name: coffee-pub-browser
description: Wraps the FoundryVTT Game and Stream views in two fixed-size Chromium windows that OBS can capture as sources.
author: Coffee Pub

scripts.check: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/config.js && node --check src/grips.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/grip-preload.js && node --check src/control/control.js && node --check src/grip/grip.js

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Coffee Pub Browser needs the microphone if you use FoundryVTT audio/video chat inside the Game window.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Coffee Pub Browser needs the camera if you use FoundryVTT audio/video chat inside the Game window.
